text:
Matvei Gridin is ahead of schedule. The 28th pick in 2024, a year out of Shawinigan, has six goals and 13 points in 22 games for Calgary, 0.59 points a game. Of the 116 forwards drafted 23rd to 33rd since 2005 with four-plus seasons, the median first full season was 0.35 points a game, and Easton Cowan, the closest comparable pick, managed 0.44.

The finishing is running a bit hot (six goals on 4.1 expected), and his last 10 games have been quieter, five points against the 6.4 we'd expect. But the Flames control play with him out there: 54% of the shot attempts and 51.5% of the expected goals at five on five, both well above the team when he sits. He's quick, 93rd percentile in top speed, and the early hand tracking backs the style. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones had him carrying the puck in on 61% of his entries and exiting with possession 65% of the time, from a small sample of eight games. He plays 16 minutes a night with five power-play points; how much more he gets is the thing to watch.
